name: commons-balloon-actions-always-v1
description: ⭐ DEAN'S QUESTION OF 12/09/2026: SHOULD THE BALLOONS BE IN EVERY GAME? As overlays/commons-balloon-actions-v1.overlay.json, PLUS aerodrome.alwaysInPlay true, AND THE TWO DIFFER IN EXACTLY ONE LEAF so the delta is the availability rule and nothing else. ⭐ WHY IT IS THE RIGHT QUESTION: the Aerodrome needs Vegetable among the decks in play, which is 3 of 5 suits at two seats, 4 of 5 at three and all 5 at four, so under the rule as built the module is ABSENT FROM ABOUT A GAME IN FIVE and most often at TWO SEATS. Under a plain-action balloon scheme that means four CORE ACTIONS have no balloon route in those games. ⭐ C1 ALREADY ANSWERED THIS SHAPE THE OTHER WAY: Dean's standing ruling 2 of 09/09/2026 puts all five Notice Boards in the centre of every game because not every suit is in play in every game and that guarantees all five actions exist in every game, and island.json's unresolved list records the same question answered the same way for the island's colours. ⚠️ THE READ IS THE 2p COLUMN, not the pooled table: at four seats every deck is in play and this leaf CANNOT do anything, so any 4p movement is noise and the arm is its own control there. ⚠️ IT IS A SETUP RULE AND NOT A COMPONENT CHANGE - four Aerodromes and four balloons already exist - but it does put a Vegetable-sheet component on a table with no Vegetable seat, which is a PITCH and ART question this run cannot answer. ⛔ NO VILLAGE STORE HERE: the Store measured badly on the commons on 12/09/2026 (Vegetable 18.1% to 17.1%, its own reshuffle prediction failing at four seats, and a worst position of 346,104 legal moves), so this arm keeps it out and asks about availability alone. ⛔ MAY NOT BE QUOTED: the bonus rate is a share of TURNS; no level is comparable with a reference-v14 or earlier number; the hand limit of 7 is the SIMULATOR'S BOUND (C7).
